lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five parallel horizontal rows, starting posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating visible grid-like anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a light-to-dark vertical gradient from the dorsal to ventral edge of each ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple orange-colored focal lesions are visible: one on the leading edge of the pectoral fin and two on the lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral surface near the pelvic fin area.
